verdict.rationale:
Reflect's AI palette can summarize, list action items/key takeaways, draft via custom prompts, and lets users 'chat' with a filtered subset of their own notes to ask questions grounded in their content, with model choice between GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet. Control over what data it sees is supported via search/filter-then-chat rather than granular per-note or per-tag AI permissions, and there's no info on whether note content sent to third-party LLMs is disclosed/controlled beyond model choice.

missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of AI answer quality, explicit documentation of data-sharing/privacy controls when notes are sent to OpenAI/Anthropic, and finer-grained data-scoping options beyond search filters.
